correctness.rationale: For each family the sequence of cubes has characteristic polynomial (z²-4z-1)(z²+z-1), with constant coefficient 1. If a prime divides all cubic windows then differencing and invertibility force cube-periodicity from index zero. For F the resulting F_k=0, F_{k+1}³=1 and odd-index Cassini F_{k+1}²=-1 are incompatible in odd characteristic. For L the first four cube congruences yield L_k=2L_{k+1}; odd-index Cassini then rules out every odd p except 5, which is ruled out by Lucas period four modulo five. Parity period three gives the lower bound two exactly for k=3 mod 6; an explicit difference modulo four excludes four, and other odd k have an odd window difference. The new standalone verifier executed successfully for 202 odd-window tests and 2,000 recurrence-index identities.

value.rationale: This is the exact natural odd-window case of the cubic extension of a published family of Fibonacci/Lucas shift-GCD problems. It gives a simultaneous complete classification for both fundamental recurrences, uniformly all odd lengths, and joins independently established even-window results to settle all positive-length cubic cases. The proof identifies an odd-characteristic cube-period obstruction rather than adding an arbitrary fixed numerical slice.
